title: Bachche Unto se Gir Gir ke
body:
Bachche oonto se gir gir ke marte rahe sabr karti rahi.
Zulm Zainab pe har gaam hote rahe sabr karti rahi.
Hathkadi bediyo me tha jakda huwa shaah ka laadla.
Aabide khasta tan jaan khote rahe sabr karti rahi.
Ghair haalat thi chal chal ke beemaar ki.
Raah purkhaar thi taaziyane bhatije k lagte rahe sabr karti rahi.
4 Saala Sakina thi laaghar bahot aur muztar bahot.
Har ghadi usko zaalim rulate rahe sabr karti rahi.
Qafela shaah ka aage badhta raha zulm hota raha.
Bibiyo.n ko sitamgar satate rahe sabr karti rahi.
Pahonchi darbar me sar khule bibiya.n thi qayamat ayaa.n.
Sar khule aale athaar rote rahe sabr karti rahi.
Ye roqayya ye Zainab ye kulsum hain shah ke maghmum hain.
Naam lekar sitamgar batate rahe sabr karti rahi.
Qaid zindaa.n me ahle haram ho gaye jannato.n ke pale.
Jaam ashko.n ke saadaat pite rahe sabr karti rahi.
Yaad Asghar Sakina ko aate rahe khu.n rulate rahe
Gham Sakina ko lori sunate rahe sabr karti rahi.
Ye azim o shajar gham ki rudaad hai waqte fariyad hai.
Zulm Zainab pe be peer dhate rahe sabr karti rahi.
